name: Agumon (X-Antibody)
look: an X-Antibody Agumon: a fiercer little dinosaur with long chrome claws and a striped tail
entry: An Agumon awakened by the X-Antibody, with long chrome claws and a fiercer, more dinosaur-like body. Its Baby Flame burns far hotter than any other Agumon's.
how: Wild: common in badlands, volcanic biomes, savannas, mountains and peaks.
